html:
GeoCalib (ETH Zurich / Microsoft, 2024): the camera of one photo (focal length, field of view) and how it is tilted (roll, pitch from gravity), from perspective fields and an optimisation; no checkerboard needed. Apache-2.0 code, CC-BY-4.0 weights; training photos of mixed licences.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: GeoCalib: Learning Single-image Calibration with Geometric Optimization, ECCV 2024, 2024-09-10
  • Original code: https://github.com/cvg/GeoCalib at 1dedb29f94fc
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-WEIGHTS
  • Weights licence: CC-BY-4.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/cvg/GeoCalib/blob/1dedb29f94fc11b896c5f572005978aeebccd67f/LICENSE ; https://github.com/cvg/GeoCalib/blob/1dedb29f94fc11b896c5f572005978aeebccd67f/README.md
  • Training data: OpenPano (perspective crops of public 360-degree panoramas: PolyHaven, HDRMaps, AmbientCG, BlenderKit) (Trained on OpenPano (README, paper Sec. 4): perspective crops of ~2.8k public 360-degree panoramas (PolyHaven, HDRMaps, AmbientCG, BlenderKit). Only the weights licence (CC-BY-4.0) counts for the commercial flag.)
  • Options: cuda_graphs = True (speed only)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: geocalib-pinhole
  • Outputs: intrinsics, gravity, roll, pitch, vfov
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): geocalib-pinhole 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved)
  • geocalib-pinhole 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 28 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • geocalib-pinhole original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; cvg/GeoCalibdedb29f94fc GeoCalib.calibrate (pinhole), its kornia resize / crop / LM fit
  • geocalib-pinhole load / first call: original 1.8 s / 0.841 s, portable 0.27 s / 1.725 s, kernels 1.25 s / 0.924 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Each image at its own size (1440 x 1920 portrait); roll, pitch and vertical field of view of the fitted camera against the ground truth; AUC of the error up to 5 degrees (errors below 1 degree count as 1, siclib's compute_auc(min_error=1)), the GeoCalib paper's protocol. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
